title: Scroll Acid Rain
html:
Monster drop: Ogre Shaman

How to get it

Teaches Acid Rain, a level-4 Acid spell. Needs 40 Intellect and Acid skill 25 to learn and to cast.

Drops from monsters that cast Acid spells, level 30+.

  • A monster that casts spells drops scrolls of its own school, so look for Acid casters.
  • The monster’s level picks the spell level: 8+ drops level-2 scrolls, 18+ level-3 and 30+ level-4.
